{{Quote|Kiki says you have surveyed the smugglers' base and are now returning to do more for our den.|[[Tika Sileste]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Exploiting a Weakness|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Smuggler Base''' was operated by the [[Talusian Smugglers]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Three hills. All well guarded. An operations building connected to their landing pad. This information indicates that the only successful approach will be to infiltrate the buildings and find ways to end their efforts from the inside.|[[Kiki Dorente]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaW" />}}
[[File:TalusianSmugglerBase.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aerial view of the base]]
The Smuggler Base was located near the city of [[Nashal]], on the planet Talus of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. It served as base of operations for the Talusian Smugglers. The base was made of several structures: an operations building, a landing pad,<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> living quarters and a supply building.<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Gather the Missing|Talus}}</ref> The base was protected by a tall defensive wall and the three hills that surrounded the base were guarded by smuggler guards.<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> Many of the operations in the base were carried out by droids, including [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droids]] and [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]]s.<ref name="SWG:EaW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Return of our people is paramount. Could you please inspect the smuggler base and look for our den mates?|[[Lika Fimente]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Gather the Missing|Talus}}</ref>}}
The Smuggler Base was located near a [[Neetha Den's cave|cave]] inhabited by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] of the [[Neetha Den]].<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several Selonians were captured by the smugglers and kept as hostages in order to force the rest of the den into mining for them.<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref>
[[File:Talusian_Smugglers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Talusian Smugglers]] patrolling near the base]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] was aware of the situation but was unable to intervene in Selonians matters. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] thus recruited an independent spacer in order to help the Selonians without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer later worked with [[Tika Sileste]],<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> [[Ravi Thienta]],<ref name="SWG:UYT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Under Your Thumb|Talus}}</ref> [[Lika Fimente]]<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> and [[Kiki Dorente]], the advisor to the [[Kiisa Kimotte|Neetha den mother]], to develop a strategy against the smugglers.<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> The spacer then attacked the base and killed many smugglers, including their leader. The spacer also destroyed the smugglers' droids,<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> and the weapon caches, and retrieved stolen Selonian supplies of food, hides and electronic parts.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> However, the spacer discovered that the captive Selonians had already been shipped to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="SWG:GtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Smuggler Base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Smuggler Base was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
